core_memory.sleep_schedule: I try to get at least 7-8 hours of sleep each night to ensure I'm well-rested for the next day. I set a consistent sleep schedule and avoid caffeine and electronics at least an hour before bedtime. It's crucial for maintaining my energy levels and focus throughout the day.
core_memory.morning_routine: I usually wake up around 6:30 AM. I check my calendar on my phone to see what's coming up that day. Then I do some basic stretching beside my bed to get energized for the day. Skipping the stretches makes me feel sluggish for at least an hour, and I don't have time for that!
core_memory.breakfast_routine: I usually start by making scrambled eggs and spinach with whole wheat toast, and brewing coffee using the single-cup machine. If I'm in a rush, I'll grab a granola bar and some fruit to eat on the go. I prioritize eating something nutritious, especially since I'm quite active.
